bad_request.title: We could not read that
bad_request.message: Add some text, a link or a screenshot and try again.

too_large.title: That file is too large
too_large.message: Pick a smaller screenshot and try again.

upstream.title: The check service is down
upstream.message: This is a problem on our side. Try again in a few minutes.

rate_limited.title: You reached the check limit
rate_limited.message: Wait a little and try again. A free account gets a higher limit.

network.title: You are offline
network.message: Check your internet connection and try again.

timeout.title: The check took too long
timeout.message: Your connection may be slow. Try again.

invalid_response.title: Unexpected answer
invalid_response.message: The check service sent an answer we could not read. Try again.

unavailable.title: Checks are not available
unavailable.message: This build is not connected to the check service. Update the app and try again.

not_found.title: That check has expired
not_found.message: Feedback is accepted for a few days after a check.

rateLimitedWait: Try again in about {{wait}}. A free account gets a higher limit.

auth.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
auth.credentialInUse: That account already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.weakPassword: Use a password with at least 6 characters.
auth.badCredential: The email or password is not right.
auth.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
auth.popupClosed: The Google window was closed before sign-in finished.
auth.differentMethod: That email already has an account with another sign-in method. Use that method.
auth.unauthorizedDomain: Sign-in is not allowed from this web address.
auth.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
auth.recentLogin: For your safety, sign in again and then repeat this step.
auth.notAllowed: This sign-in method is not available yet.
auth.fallback: Something went wrong. Please try again.
